install: npm install --prefix /tmp/openclaw-probe openclaw@latest (Node v24.22.2 via fnm)
isolation: OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-probe/state; OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/openclaw-probe/openclaw.json; gateway run --dev --port 18799 --bind loopback --auth token; no existing gateway touched
redaction: bin/redact.py plus targeted redaction of token/secret/password/api_key/recoveryScope/capability/nonce keys and /__openclaw__/cap/<id> URLs
